Title: Verify Currency grid default state
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Currency tab is active
Steps: 1. Navigate to Setup > Location > 1604 -- "Currency" tab 2. Verify grid structure
Expected Result: Grid displays 3 currencies (USD, CAD, MXN) with correct column headers

Title: Verify USD default configuration
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Currency tab is active
Steps: 1. Open "Currency" tab 2. Check USD row
Expected Result: USD is selected and set as default with merchant assigned

Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Currency tab is active

Title: Verify Is Default Enables When Currency Is Selected
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Currency tab is active
Steps: 1. CAD "Is Default" is disabled (initial state) 2. Click CAD "Selected" checkbox 3. Verify CAD "Is Default"

Title: Single default rule - auto-uncheck previous default
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Currency tab is active

Title: Merchant change persists after save and reload
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Currency tab is active
Steps: 1. Reload and navigate to "Currency" tab 2. Open USD "Merchant" dropdown, select "316426 - Encore Bahamas/USD" 3. Verify USD "Merchant" field 4. Verify "Save" enabled 5. Click "Save" 6. Verify "Save" disabled 7. Reload and navigate to "Currency" tab 8. Verify USD "Merchant"
Expected Result: Changing merchant and saving persists the selection through page reload

Title: IsDefault change persists after save and reload (cascade)
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Currency tab is active
Steps: 1. Reload and navigate to "Currency" tab 2. Check CAD "Selected" checkbox 3. Check CAD "Is Default" checkbox 4. Verify USD "Is Default" auto-unchecked 5. Verify "Save" enabled 6. Click "Save" 7. Verify "Save" disabled 8. Reload and navigate to "Currency" tab 9. Verify CAD "Is Default" 10. Verify USD "Is Default"

Title: Combined changes persist after single save and reload
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Currency tab is active
Steps: 1. Reload and navigate to "Currency" tab 2. Check CAD "Selected" checkbox 3. Change USD "Merchant" to "316426 - Encore Bahamas/USD" 4. Verify "Save" enabled 5. Click "Save" (single save for both changes) 6. Verify "Save" disabled 7. Reload and navigate to "Currency" tab 8. Verify CAD "Selected" 9. Verify USD "Merchant"
Expected Result: Multiple changes in a single save cycle all persist through page reload

Title: Cancel save discards changes - reload shows original state
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Currency tab is active
Steps: 1. Reload and navigate to "Currency" tab 2. Check CAD "Selected" checkbox 3. Verify "Save" enabled 4. Click "Save" button 5. Click "Cancel" on Save Changes dialog 6. Reload and navigate to "Currency" tab 7. Verify CAD "Selected"
Expected Result: Cancelling the Save Changes dialog discards all pending changes
Notes: No cleanup needed - cancel means nothing was saved
